text:
Maya Patel: uploaded a quick screencap of the Compliance > Privacy panel. two small but recurring UX issues i spotted: the encryption badge copy and the audit search placeholder. Samir Khan: on it. can you mark the exact spots in the image? Maya Patel: top-right lock pill on each dataset card. it says 'Encrypted' but the tooltip reads 'Managed by Redwood KMS' even when customers have BYOK. confusing. also pill hover/focus contrast looks weak. Olivia Reed: for copy, how about short pill text: 'Encrypted (Redwood)' and 'Encrypted (Customer)'? tooltip can expand: 'Redwood-managed key' vs 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Sophie Chen: accessibility: pill is not keyboard-focusable before card actions. tab order should hit the pill first. when focused via keyboard there's no visible ring currently. needs focus outline and ARIA label like 'Encryption: customer-managed'. :keyboard: :warning: Alex Gómez: +1. also region selector defaults to alphabetical in the mock. we wanted to prefer the user's last-used region or account preference then show latency-sorted options. is that in the latest figma? Maya Patel: current mock is alphabetical. will update. audit log search: placeholder just says 'search events...' which causes tickets asking what fields we support. Samir Khan: suggest placeholder -> 'Search events, user email, or key ID'. explicit and short. Olivia Reed: and the filter chip currently 'KMS: any' — 'KMS' is internal jargon. propose 'Key provider: any' or 'Key owner: any'. Sophie Chen: screen reader issue on retention slider: when using arrow keys, live announcement says just the number ("30") not the unit. should be 'Retention: 30 days'. we need an aria-live element that reads the full phrase. Maya Patel: here's a tiny example i used that worked in testing: ```
Retention: 30 days
``` Samir Khan: frontend can implement that. backend unaffected. Alex Gómez: modal CTA wording: currently 'Enable encryption' but this action also binds a key for BYOK flows. customers expect separate choices. recommend splitting CTAs: 'Enable (Redwood-managed)' and 'Bind key & enable' and a tiny helper line explaining consequences. Olivia Reed: copy suggestion for helper line: 'Choose a key from your account or let Redwood manage one. This encrypts stored artifacts.' shorter alt: 'Pick a key or use Redwood-managed. Encrypts stored data.' Maya Patel: short alt reads fine to me. Sophie Chen: contrast numbers: pill hover state is currently ~3.2:1 per Axe. need >=4.5:1. simple fix: darken text by ~18% and keep background same. i'll run numbers on the prototype colors. Alex Gómez: i'll push color swatches and include automated test steps for contrast regression. design-bot: new mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/rad/privacy-panel-v5 — includes region pref, clarified audit placeholders, split CTAs, focus ring fixes, and updated badge colors. Maya Patel: can folks review today? aiming to ship in next console patch. Samir Khan: i'll review after 4pm PT. Olivia Reed: i'll do copy + a11y pass by EOD. Sophie Chen: i'll run keyboard walkthrough and Axe tomorrow AM and post results here. Alex Gómez: will add contrast regression test and a note in the QA checklist. Maya Patel: thanks all! i'll update the PR with the copy and the aria-live snippet. linking product review doc after merge. :sparkles:
